# Data Model: Blob Copy Feature

**Created**: January 4, 2026
**Status**: Complete

## Entity Definitions

### BlobCopyOperation

Primary entity representing a single blob copy operation.

```csharp
public class BlobCopyOperation
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Unique identifier for this copy operation (UUID v4, generated by backend)
    /// </summary>
    public string Id { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Source blob URI (validated Azure Blob Storage URI)
    /// Format: https://[account].blob.core.windows.net/[container]/[blob]
    /// </summary>
    public string SourceUri { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Destination blob URI (validated Azure Blob Storage URI)
    /// Format: https://[account].blob.core.windows.net/[container]/[blob]
    /// </summary>
    public string DestinationUri { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Current status of the copy operation
    /// </summary>
    public BlobCopyStatus Status { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Progress as percentage (0-100)
    /// Updated in real-time via SignalR
    /// </summary>
    public decimal ProgressPercentage { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Bytes transferred so far
    /// </summary>
    public long BytesTransferred { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Total bytes to transfer
    /// Known after initial blob properties fetch
    /// </summary>
    public long TotalBytes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Estimated time remaining in seconds
    /// Calculated from current transfer rate
    /// </summary>
    public int? EstimatedTimeRemaining { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Error message if operation failed
    /// Null if operation is pending, in-progress, or completed successfully
    /// </summary>
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Error code for programmatic handling
    /// Used for retry logic, logging categorization
    /// </summary>
    public string ErrorCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Timestamp when copy operation was initiated (ISO 8601)
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime StartedAt { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Timestamp when copy operation completed (ISO 8601)
    /// Null if operation is still pending or in-progress
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Correlation ID for distributed tracing
    /// Links this operation to Application Insights traces, logs, and requests
    /// </summary>
    public string CorrelationId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Username/principal ID of the user who initiated the copy
    /// Populated from Entra ID claims
    /// </summary>
    public string InitiatedBy { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cancellation token state
    /// True if user has requested cancellation; operation may still be completing
    /// </summary>
    public bool CancellationRequested { get; set; }
}
```

### BlobCopyStatus

Enumeration of all possible states for a copy operation.

```csharp
public enum BlobCopyStatus
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Operation created but not yet started
    /// Validation has passed; waiting for copy to begin
    /// </summary>
    Pending = 1,

    /// <summary>
    /// Copy operation is actively transferring data
    /// Progress updates are being sent via SignalR
    /// </summary>
    InProgress = 2,

    /// <summary>
    /// Copy completed successfully
    /// Destination blob is fully available and matches source
    /// </summary>
    Completed = 3,

    /// <summary>
    /// Copy operation failed
    /// Check ErrorMessage and ErrorCode for details
    /// Retry is available unless it's a permanent error (auth, not found, etc.)
    /// </summary>
    Failed = 4,

    /// <summary>
    /// User cancelled the operation
    /// May have transferred partial data depending on cancellation timing
    /// </summary>
    Cancelled = 5
}
```

### ProgressUpdate

Data structure sent to clients via SignalR during active copy operations.

```csharp
public class ProgressUpdate
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Unique identifier of the copy operation
    /// </summary>
    public string CopyOperationId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Bytes transferred in this update interval
    /// </summary>
    public long BytesTransferred { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Total bytes for the entire blob
    /// </summary>
    public long TotalBytes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Progress percentage (0-100)
    /// </summary>
    public decimal ProgressPercentage { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Estimated seconds remaining (rounded)
    /// Null if indeterminate
    /// </summary>
    public int? EstimatedSecondsRemaining { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Timestamp of this progress update (ISO 8601)
    /// Used for client-side progress rate calculation
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime UpdatedAt { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Transfer rate in MB/s
    /// For display purposes
    /// </summary>
    public decimal TransferRateMbps { get; set; }
}
```

### ValidationError

Details about a validation failure.

```csharp
public class ValidationError
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Field that failed validation
    /// e.g., "sourceUri", "destinationUri"
    /// </summary>
    public string Field { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Error message describing the validation failure
    /// User-friendly, actionable
    /// </summary>
    public string Message { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Error code for programmatic handling
    /// e.g., "INVALID_URI_FORMAT", "URI_NOT_FOUND", "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS"
    /// </summary>
    public string Code { get; set; }
}
```

## State Machine

### Blob Copy Operation Lifecycle

```
┌─────────┐
│ Pending │  (operation created, validation passed)
└────┬────┘
     │
     │ (user clicks "Copy" button)
     ↓
┌──────────────┐
│ In Progress  │  (copy actively transferring)
└─┬──────────┬─┘
  │          │
  │          │ (user clicks "Cancel")
  │          └──────────────┐
  │                         ↓
  │                    ┌──────────┐
  │                    │Cancelled │ (partial data may exist)
  │                    └──────────┘
  │
  │ (all bytes transferred)
  ↓
┌───────────┐
│ Completed │  (destination blob fully available)
└───────────┘

OR

┌──────────┐
│ Failed   │  (error occurred, destination unchanged)
│          │  (user can see error, retry is available)
└──────────┘
```

### State Transition Rules

| From | To | Trigger | Precondition |
|------|----|---------|----|
| Pending | InProgress | Copy initiated | Validation passed |
| InProgress | Completed | All bytes transferred | No errors during copy |
| InProgress | Failed | Exception or error response | Any error during copy |
| InProgress | Cancelled | User cancels operation | User action |
| Failed | Pending | User retries | Only for transient errors |
| Cancelled | Pending | User retries | Manual user action |

---

## Validation Rules

### URI Validation

**Pattern**: `https://[storageAccount].blob.core.windows.net/[container]/[blobPath]`

**Rules**:
1. Must be HTTPS (not HTTP)
2. Must be valid Azure Blob Storage URI (blob.core.windows.net)
3. Container and blob names must follow Azure naming rules:
   - Container: lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, 3-63 characters
   - Blob: any UTF-8 characters except null, up to 1024 characters
4. Source URI and destination URI must not be identical (case-insensitive comparison)
   - Error code: IDENTICAL_URIS
   - Validated on both client-side (for UX) and server-side (for security)
4. Both sourceUri and destinationUri must pass format validation
5. sourceUri and destinationUri must NOT be identical
6. Blob must exist at sourceUri (checked on server-side before copy starts)
7. Destination container must exist or be creatable by authenticated user

**Error Codes**:
- `INVALID_URI_FORMAT`: URI doesn't match blob storage pattern
- `IDENTICAL_URIS`: Source and destination are the same
- `SOURCE_NOT_FOUND`: Source blob doesn't exist
- `DESTINATION_INACCESSIBLE`: Destination container doesn't exist or permission denied
- `INVALID_CONTAINER_NAME`: Container name violates Azure naming rules
- `EMPTY_FIELD`: Required field is empty

### Business Logic Validation

1. **Blob Size**: 
   - Minimum: 1 byte
   - Maximum: Based on Azure Blob Storage limits (currently 190.7 TB)
   - Constraint: System supports up to multi-gigabyte sizes with streaming

2. **Timeout**:
   - Default timeout: 30 minutes per blob copy operation
   - User notification: "Copy operation timed out. Please retry."
   - Retry available: Yes (operation marked as Failed)

3. **Destination Handling** (per clarification):
   - If destination blob already exists:
     - Prompt user with dialog: "Destination blob already exists. Overwrite, Cancel, or choose new destination?"
     - User selection determines next action
     - System respects user choice (no silent overwrites)

4. **Concurrent Operations**:
   - Per user session: Only 1 copy operation at a time (MVP)
   - Multiple blobs can be queued in future versions
   - Current blob copy doesn't block other user activities

## Persistence (if applicable)

**Current Scope**: In-memory state for MVP
- BlobCopyOperation state stored in memory during operation
- Progress updates cached for last 5 minutes
- No persistent storage required for MVP

**Future Enhancement**: Could use Azure Cosmos DB or SQL Database for:
- Operation audit trail
- User analytics (blobs copied, success rate)
- Resume capability for interrupted operations

---

## Error Handling & Recovery

### Retryable Errors

Errors where user should attempt retry:
- Network timeouts
- Service unavailable (503)
- Too many requests (429)
- Transient blob storage failures

**Retry Strategy**: Exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 30s max)

### Non-Retryable Errors

Errors requiring user action before retry:
- Invalid URI format (fix the URI)
- Source blob not found (check source URI)
- Insufficient permissions (need storage account access)
- Destination container inaccessible (need permissions or create container)

**User Action**: Display error message with guidance; allow new copy attempt with different URIs

## TypeScript Interfaces (Frontend)

```typescript
interface BlobCopyOperation {
  id: string;
  sourceUri: string;
  destinationUri: string;
  status: BlobCopyStatus;
  progressPercentage: number;
  bytesTransferred: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  estimatedTimeRemaining?: number;
  errorMessage?: string;
  errorCode?: string;
  startedAt: string; // ISO 8601
  completedAt?: string; // ISO 8601
  correlationId: string;
}

type BlobCopyStatus = 'pending' | 'in-progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';

interface ProgressUpdate {
  copyOperationId: string;
  bytesTransferred: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  progressPercentage: number;
  estimatedSecondsRemaining?: number;
  updatedAt: string; // ISO 8601
  transferRateMbps: number;
}

interface ValidationError {
  field: string;
  message: string;
  code: string;
}
```

---

## Summary

- **Primary Entity**: `BlobCopyOperation` with 5-state lifecycle
- **Real-time Updates**: `ProgressUpdate` sent via SignalR every ~1-5 seconds
- **Validation**: URI format, existence, permissions, and business rules
- **Error Handling**: Retryable vs. non-retryable with user guidance
- **Persistence**: In-memory for MVP; ready for future DB integration
- **Tracing**: Correlation ID for Application Insights integration
